subject: Access tagging & provisioning samples for SIG intake
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@medtechco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medtechco.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — provisioning samples & role taxonomy request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on — our security team is pulling together the SIG intake for Redwood and we need a small sample package to validate your provisioning controls (SSO/SAML, SCIM deltas, RBAC/role tagging). Specifically we are looking for:

- a short SCIM delta export (anonymized) showing create/update/deactivate events
- a simple role-tagging taxonomy or mapping file that shows how roles map to permissions (e.g. "product_read", "billing_admin")
- the SAML assertion sample or assertion attribute list you use for default role assignment

We don't need full logs — a few rows/examples are sufficient. Can you also call out any PII that will be redacted so we can confirm acceptance? Targeting SIG review next Tuesday — would you be able to send samples by EOD tomorrow (Fri)?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Monroe
Senior Information Security Manager
MedTechCo

--

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@medtechco.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — provisioning samples & role taxonomy request

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the clear list. We'll prepare a small bundle with:

- SCIM delta sample (CSV) showing 6 events: 2 creates, 2 updates, 2 deactivations, with all email/usernames redacted
- Role-tagging mapping (XLSX) with a short legend for tag semantics (admin, app_support, analytics_read, billing_admin)
- Example SAML assertion attributes we set in IdP mapping and the rule we use to assign "default_role" on first provision

Quick clarifications:
1) For the SCIM sample, do you prefer a field-level redaction (replace email with example@redacted.local) or complete removal of the email column?
2) On role mapping, we'll include both human-readable role names and the internal tag keys. Is the SIG team OK with an internal-key column that we mark as "internal_only"?

Priyom — assigning the artifact prep. Please pull a sanitized SCIM delta export from staging and attach the role-tagging sheet. Sean, flag any known tenant-specific caveats we should note.

We can hit EOD tomorrow for the initial package. If you need it sooner, tell us and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@medtechco.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — provisioning samples & role taxonomy request

Hi team,

Attached: scim-delta-sample.csv (6 rows) and role-tagging-mapping.xlsx. Notes below.

Attachment stubs:
- scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV, 6 rows) — columns: event_type, user_id, external_id, op, timestamp, email_redacted, displayName
- role-tagging-mapping.xlsx (XLSX) — two sheets: tags_to_permissions, tag_legend

Sanitization approach:
- All email and external_id values replaced with example@redacted.local and EXTERNAL-REDACTED-### respectively.
- User IDs are pseudonymized (uid-xxxx).
- Timestamps left in ISO format; no IP addresses included.

Important caveats:
- Our staging delta export may not show cross-tenant authorization exceptions that can occur on migrations — those are runtime-specific and not present in a small sample.
- Role assignment rules: first provision checks SAML attribute "department" and an IdP group claim; we fall back to "default_role" when attributes are missing. See a short comment row in the XLSX.

If the SIG team needs field-level hashes instead of redaction we can produce SHA256 hashes for the values (takes ~30m).

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Engineering Manager, Provisioning
Redwood Inference

--

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@medtechco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medtechco.com, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — provisioning samples & role taxonomy request

Irene / Priyom — received the attachments and the notes, thanks. The redaction format (example@redacted.local) is fine for SIG intake. A few quick asks before we close the intake:

- Could you add one comment row in the CSV that indicates the SCIM schema version used and whether group membership events are included?
- Please mark the "internal_only" column in the XLSX clearly — we'll treat those columns as non-shareable outside the review team.

If you can drop those tiny edits by EOD today, we can route to the SIG panel tomorrow morning. Otherwise Tuesday is acceptable.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Senior Information Security Manager
MedTechCo

--
